summary: ABSTRACT SYNTAX TREE (AST) & METAPROGRAMMING: explanations and runnable examples.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
```python name=advanced/metaprogramming.py
# ============================================================
# AST — Analyze and Modify Python Code Programmatically
# ============================================================
import ast
import inspect

# --- Parse and analyze code ---
code = """
def greet(name):
    return f"Hello, {name}!"

class User:
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name = name
"""

tree = ast.parse(code)

# Find all function definitions
for node in ast.walk(tree):
    if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef):
        print(f"Function: {node.name} at line {node.lineno}")
    elif isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
        print(f"Class: {node.name} at line {node.lineno}")

# --- Inspect module (runtime introspection) ---
def my_function(a: int, b: str = "hello") -> bool:
    """A sample function."""
    return True

print(inspect.signature(my_function))     # (a: int, b: str = 'hello') -> bool
print(inspect.getsource(my_function))     # Source code as string
print(inspect.getdoc(my_function))        # Docstring
print(inspect.isfunction(my_function))    # True
print(inspect.isclass(str))               # True

# Get all members of a module/class
members = inspect.getmembers(str, predicate=inspect.ismethod)

# --- Dynamic class creation ---
def create_model(name: str, fields: dict):
    """Dynamically create a dataclass."""
    from dataclasses import make_dataclass
    return make_dataclass(name, fields.items())

UserModel = create_model("UserModel", {"name": str, "age": int, "email": str})
user = UserModel(name="Veera", age=30, email="v@test.com")

# --- exec and eval (use with extreme caution!) ---
# eval: evaluate a single expression
result = eval("2 + 3 * 4")  # 14

# exec: execute multiple statements
namespace = {}
exec("""
def dynamic_func(x):
    return x * 2
""", namespace)
print(namespace["dynamic_func"](5))  # 10

# ⚠️ NEVER use eval/exec with user input! Security risk!

# --- getattr, setattr, hasattr, delattr ---
class Config:
    debug = True
    port = 8000

config = Config()
print(getattr(config, "debug"))              # True
print(getattr(config, "missing", "default")) # "default"
setattr(config, "host", "localhost")
print(hasattr(config, "host"))               # True
delattr(config, "host")
```
